# Lucie Creatives — Digital Creative & Growth Agency

> Lucie Creatives is a premier full-stack digital creative and growth agency. We specialize in high-retention short-form video editing, cinematic widescreen commercial films, monolithic visual branding systems, and algorithmic social media growth.

## Core Capabilities
- Short Form Videos: Scroll-stopping 9:16 viral reels, TikToks, YouTube shorts with sub-1-second hooks, kinetic typography, and audio triggers.
- Long Form Videos: 16:9 widescreen commercial films, 4K brand documentaries, 3D product keynote reveals, DaVinci Resolve color grading.
- Graphic Design: Monolithic brand identity design systems, editorial lookbooks, physical packaging architecture, digital marketing assets.
- Social Media Growth: Algorithmic content pipelines, organic reach scaling, community acquisition.
